title: polypodium vulgare f. perpusillum
intro: Polypodium vulgare f. perpusillum, commonly known as the American polypody, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may contribute to the improvement of cardiovascular health and immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium vulgare f. perpusillum include anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects, which may help to protect against cell damage and support the body's natural defenses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various polyphenols, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
